dedupe_keys.name: greenery inventory portal of azerbaijan agac az

description: The Greenery Inventory Portal is an online map of inventoried trees and green areas in Azerbaijan. The Greenery Inventory Project is run on the initiative of the IDEA Public Union with the support of the Ministry of Ecology and Natural Resources, and its main goal is to strengthen the protection of green areas in the city, monitor the current condition of trees and ensure their continuous protection. The portal has a map with a search and filters by inventory type (all, greenery, and forest fund lands), an insights page with statistics, QR codes for trees, an about page and a tree planting page, in Azerbaijani and English. Access to the map is free online; no licence or download is stated on the page read. Caveats: the portal loads its map and statistics by script, so the number of trees and the attributes recorded could not be read, and the city covered is not named on the home page. Coverage is Azerbaijan, mainly urban areas. It supports green infrastructure and urban heat analysis, such as tree condition monitoring along streets and utility corridors; related records are the Hong Kong tree register and the Copenhagen street trees.
